answers.core: It seems and inherent part of the Tilemap/Tileset behaviour, but maybe it could be solved with an addon. I really don't know enough about addons to tell.
answers.workaround: It can be work around by extracting the collision object from each tile in tileset/tilemap I suppose, but I have not tried to do that and it would be code that does not belong in the game, but rather in the engine. I have done similar technical work-arounds previously and they tend to break on updates of  the engine.

title: Make Tilemap/Tileset emit signals on collisions
